about: The negative corpus of N-26 slice 4 (docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md, 'Slice 4'). Every row is a YouTube upload as `read_upload(title, uploader)` sees it, with the artist, the song and the basis it must give. A rule of the reader is accepted only if NO negative row changes. Kinds: `negative` = the reading is right under the design (a performer named by the title, or an upload that names nobody keeping its uploader flagged `channel`, the design's stop-gap); `fixed` = wrong before, a target of slice 4 (`before` holds the old reading); `leftover` = wrong before AND after, `why` says what it needs and which task owns it. Rows come from the recorded answers (tests/fixtures/ytm), the tests of the readers and hand-written titles that use live, op, ed, ost, session, by, in and at as ordinary words, in four alphabets.
